reviews.author: Gabrial Taylor
reviews.text: Would give this place 6 stars if I could my usual mechanic checked it out and said it was a busted head gasket but they couldn’t fix it so my family suggested I go here instead, so I take it here and they have it for less than 24 hours and tell me it wasn’t a head gasket but a busted thermostat, they could have easily just lied to me and taken a paycheck but they didn’t and my repair went from a 3000$ repair to a 300$ repair. These guys are awesome

reviews.author: Amanda Dill
reviews.text: I have had 2 cars worked on here and each time these gentlemen have really went above and beyond and at a very fair price. They also take the time to show and explain what they've done , which to a layperson like me is quite helpful, and they're not out to get you as far as cost. Very nice, honest and hard working guys and we appreciate them greatly. Will not take our vehicles anywhere else and highly recommend them to anyone!

reviews.author: Krissy Spero
reviews.text: They have been a huge help with getting my Tahoe back to being a reliable vehicle again as well as installing new shocks. They have also worked on one of my work vehicles that was having a gas tank sealing issue that is now working great. I first went to them back in November and I have chosen to go back for minor things that I have been holding off on. They are nice guys who will do right by you at a vary fair cost.

reviews.author: spartan grunt
reviews.text: This place had my truck for a total of nine months for two transmission repair jobs. The first was initial rebuild, which lasted less than a week, and the second was to fix their first display of incompetence. That second attempt also failed in less than a week. Both instances they claimed wasn’t their fault. Total cost counting the tows was almost six grand. Cost in aggravation, incalculable. Only take your vehicle to this shade tree mechanic if you want to get screwed over.

reviews.author: Tarrin Evans
reviews.text: Great FAST service with a friendly helpful attitude. Offered us waters and flavor packs, turned a fan on for us and gave us great info on the part we were having repaired for later use warranty! Thank y’all so much for the best service we’d had in a while!

reviews.author: Johnathan Wind
reviews.text: I am from Wisconsin and was driving through the area when my car broke down. Asheville was 40 miles north and Spartanburg was still 20 miles south and with no other city in the area, I thought I was screwed. Gave these guys a call and they stayed open late to look at my car. Jonathan, Jason, and the other gentleman (whose name I cannot remember) were super friendly and helpful. They also gave me a great price for the time they spent looking at it. Overall best experience I’ve ever had with a mechanic!

reviews.author: Angie Rawding
reviews.text: Had a break down on Saturday afternoon of Memorial Day weekend. The wrecker arrived about 12:30. I had called ahead to make sure they were open, many were closed for the holiday. Wrecker driver took me home and took my truck to A-One. Got a text with a cost estimate, 2 hours later I had a new alternator and a new mechanic! Will take all my vehicles to A-One from now on. Great folks, courteous, efficient and extremely knowledgeable.

reviews.author: Ninfa Riley
reviews.text: My daughter and family were visiting from Indiana and had car problems. They had a wonderful experience here at A1 and were able to get back on the road. The mechanic diagnosed the problem and repaired the car right away. He even took the kids over to a restaurant to wait there while he repaired their vehicle. They had called several other places and no one else would see them over a holiday weekend. 5 thumbs up for this place.

reviews.author: Bonnie Garner
reviews.text: My husband got his alternator fixed here. The gentlemen that took care of him was super nice. They had his car ready pretty quickly and its running great.

reviews.author: Gordon Punt
reviews.text: Driving home to Florida the alternator I just had replaced 2 days ago went bad. Only nearby shop open on Saturday was A One. They replaced it within a couple of hours and I was on my way. Really appreciated how they explained the repairs and enjoyed chatting with Jonathan while he worked. Owner even called next day to see if we made it home. Great service and highly recommend.

reviews.author: Lance Kaminer
reviews.text: Had some work done on my Honda Element, and Lalji and Johnathan treated me great. I needed new suspension and CV Axles. They do good work and seem like good guys. I plan to take my wife’s car up there for some break work, and I feel confident they will do great.

reviews.author: Jonathan Brake
reviews.text: This is the kind of place I wish I had in my home town. Down to earth, nothing fancy, good mechanics who are also good blokes. I did a mechanical check of a car I was purchasing and it revealed some things needed doing which still made it a decent deal. These guys swung into action, fixed or replaced the parts needed always ahead of schedule, then checked in with me the following days to see how it was all going. Wish they were closer - they'd be my guys for sure. I recommend.

reviews.author: Tina Glenn
reviews.text: Reasonable and honest! Does reliable work. They also sell vehicles for a reasonable price. I bought my son Tahoe from them in 2020 and have not had any major mechanical issues. I highly recommend!!!

reviews.author: Jannie Moore
reviews.text: We were from Tennessee we left a few days ago we got to campanello South Carolina and the timing was right I guess because our water pump went out on our truck we didn't know no one or nothing I called this garage this guy said where was I at and asked me if I could get the truck to his garage these guys was our saving grace they stopped what they were doing and started working on our truck this was no easy job either they fixed our truck in record time and got us back on the road to Florida we made there and back home with not one problem these guys are amazing ppl recommend highly because if we had not been so lucky. Our outcome would have been different honest hard working men thank you again God bless

reviews.author: dennis worley
reviews.text: These guys are the only people I let work on my cars. Their are honest, and dependable and that's something there's just not enough left of these days. These guys helped me rebuild my dodge ram for my daughter almost from scratch. They have done work on our BMW, and my Camaro. I would trust them with anything. Stop and check them out if you need anything auto done!

reviews.author: Noah Merrill
reviews.text: Went there yesterday and got my wheel bearing done on my 2010 Nissan Altima.Jonathan the mechanic was one of the best mechanics I have ever met in my life.No other mechanic charges better than they do.I highly recommend it for anyone looking for a mechanic that charges you for a low price.I will definitely be coming back to this shop as In he is the only mechanic that I trust to work on my car.Thank u So much for all u do and thank u for taking ur time to get the job done right.

reviews.author: Priscilla Roberts
reviews.text: These guys are a rare gem! Know their S**t and priced affordable. I had my car broke down on the side of I-26 (with my kids) and no other auto services would answer their phone. Fabulous customer service and masters at what they do!

reviews.author: Jonathan Deng
reviews.text: Our car broke down on the way to Spartanburg from Asheville. The guys had our car up and running within 4 hours. They saved our holiday plan. Thank you!

reviews.author: Payal Kerai
reviews.text: Best service in the area. They perform almost every service you need and with quality effort with really good price. Very impressed with all the work they’ve done on my vehicle.

reviews.author: thomas williamson
reviews.text: Wouldn't let anyone else work on my vehicles! these mechanics are the best! Fast honest dependable service at an affordable price.

reviews.author: Sapphira Penny
reviews.text: They’re the ABSOLUTE BEST!!!!! When I first came, they knew exactly what the problem was and FIXED IT!!!! They do not over price and is definitely on their Sh*t!!!! It’s all in the name itself, A1!!!!! Highly recommend !!!!

reviews.author: Viddhi Kerai
reviews.text: i just started driving and i got my car from here! the price was so reasonable and the car is very reliable! i definitely recommend!!!

reviews.author: Eddie Williams
reviews.text: Lalji and Jonathan are amazing mechanics and critical thinkers! They recently worked on all of my vehicles including a diesel. They got down to the problem on each one and delivered the best solution without overcharging! My 5.4 Triton runs better than when I bougth it 12 years ago. They are the ones to go to!! They are so old school retro good, I'm going to say, "They are all that and a bag of chips!"

reviews.author: Mads
reviews.text: Johnathan was amazing! My family and I were headed to Myrtle beach when our car stopped working. We eventually found a one automotive and had to leave our car there, he was nice enough to take us to a hotel nearby & even fixed our car after two days!
